notes: Pure public-API Create Federation Execution cases use adapter-owned FOM modules declaring a user-defined transportation type. Equal duplicates compose and the joined member resolves the standard transportation handle/name lookup. Conflicting note references or reliability values reject as InconsistentFOM; the current C++ note-conflict lane also rejects a period-containing transportation name as InconsistentFOM and rejects a non-enumerated reliability value as InvalidFOM, while the valid No/Yes controls are accepted. The invalid-name fixture is valid DIF XML; the invalid-reliability fixture is intentionally rejected by the pinned DIF XSD enumeration. Installed-package focused CTest and direct TCK execution each passed 4/4 across primary/contract scenarios and both callback models (out/mgw/transportation-table-20261108.json and .xml). The Semantics prose-quality requirement is separately dispositioned to the FOM/SOM author because the public API has no oracle for its adequacy. Existing Java parity evidence covers only the prior equal/note-conflict scenarios; these new negative table cases have C++ evidence only. Other Java providers, actual transport delivery guarantees, broader transportation behavior, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
